title: (RHSA-2026:2180) Important: Self-service automation portal 2.0 security update
portal_summary: Updated images are now available for Self-service automation portal 2.0, which include new features, bug fixes, and enhancements for Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform integration with Red Hat Developer Hub.
portal_synopsis: Important: Self-service automation portal 2.0 security update
portal_product_filter: Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform|Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform|2|x86_64
portal_solution: For more about Ansible plugins for Red Hat Developer Hub, see References links
portal_description:
Self-service automation portal 2.0 delivers an Ansible-first Red Hat Developer Hub
user experience that simplifies the automation experience for Ansible users of all skill levels.
The Ansible plug-ins provide curated content and features to accelerate Ansible learner
onboarding and streamline Ansible use case adoption across your organization.
Security Fix(es):
  * automation-portal 
    * CVE-2025-61140
